name: paper-tales
vibe: A pop-up storybook. The whole film happens inside ONE physical book lying on a soft desk: the cover opens, real 3D PAGES TURN between chapters, and every scene is a warm paper spread whose contents FOLD UP from the page crease like a children's pop-up book. A pen HANDWRITES each line, paper friends blink, watercolour blooms soak into the page, a paper sun spins its rays, and a pop-up paper cinema shows the product. Cream paper, soft dusty-rose / sky / mint / lilac / butter pastels, a muted plum ink, Fraunces serif (with an italic 'handwritten' voice). Rendered as a native GSAP + SVG/CSS composition. Best for gentle, warm, human, founder-story / onboarding / 'every idea deserves a story' films.
